title: [Master]-Fixed Asset: Declining-Balance method - wrong calculation when running depreciation
summary: Fixed incorrect depreciation calculation when using the declining-balance method in fixed asset depreciation processing across multiple localization layers.
key_points: Depreciation calculation for declining-balance method was producing wrong results
Fix applied to the Depreciation Calculation codeunit across five localization layers (W1, FR, GB, IT, RU)
Test cases added to verify the declining-balance depreciation calculation
Changes ensure accurate depreciation amounts when running fixed asset depreciation
